Subject: Reprioritize: short-notice demo — need to shift due to SE double-booking

Hi Sara — quick heads up. We have a last-minute staffing conflict on our side: Karthik (the SE scheduled for your deep-dive) was double-booked by an internal P0 incident and won’t be available at 10:00 PT today.

We can either:
- move the demo 30–60 minutes later today (11:00 PT or 11:30 PT) so the same SE can lead, or
- keep 10:00 PT and have Marissa (AE) run a condensed high-level walk-through now and book a follow-up technical session with Karthik later this week.

I’m attaching the one-page agenda and will update the calendar invite once you confirm which option you prefer. Apologies for the short notice — we want to make sure you get the right technical coverage.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Reprioritize: short-notice demo — need to shift due to SE double-booking

Thanks for the heads up, Irene.

We actually have an internal leadership sync that leaked into the 11:00 PT window — tight schedule today. Can we do 11:45 PT instead? If that’s still rough, we’d prefer to keep a short 10:00 PT intro (30 min) and then schedule the in-depth technical session for Wednesday morning.

Given the execs on the call, it might be best to have Marissa run a 20–25 minute executive-focused overview at 10:00 PT and then follow up with the full demo with Karthik on Wednesday 09:00 PT.

Sara Li
Head of Partnerships | Brightrail
sara.li@brightrail.com
